summary: Innate Pharma furnished a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 2026 business update and financial results. The filing covers clinical pipeline progress (lacutamab, IPH4502, monalizumab, IPH5201) and a cash position of €25.4M with runway to Q3 2026. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine business update, not a special-situation event.
